summary.intent: Fix two bugs in the release-gate.yml workflow: the Web E2E check was evaluating the overall CI E2E conclusion instead of the Web E2E job specifically, and the Desktop E2E check was looking for standalone desktop-e2e.yml runs that don't exist when the workflow is called via workflow_call.
summary.outcome: Both checks were rewritten to use a consistent pattern: find the ci-e2e.yml orchestrator run, then check the specific named job within it. Changes were committed to a feature branch.

repo: cipher-box uses a release-gate.yml that verifies E2E test results before allowing releases to proceed.
desktop-e2e.yml and web-e2e.yml are called as reusable workflows via workflow_call from ci-e2e.yml — they do not produce standalone workflow run entries in the GitHub API.
The canonical way to trigger both E2E suites so the release gate can find them is to manually dispatch ci-e2e.yml on main.
Standalone dispatches of web-e2e.yml or desktop-e2e.yml are NOT picked up by the release gate — only runs triggered through ci-e2e.yml are.

code.finding: Web E2E check was gating on the overall ci-e2e orchestrator conclusion before inspecting the Web E2E job, so a Desktop E2E failure would cause the web check to fail even if Web E2E passed.

Desktop E2E check was searching for standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflow runs, which never exist when the workflow is invoked via workflow_call — desktop jobs appear as jobs within the ci-e2e.yml run instead.

workflow: GitHub's workflow_call mechanism does not create separate top-level workflow run entries; reusable workflow jobs appear as jobs within the calling workflow's run.
When checking job-level results via the GitHub API, you must look up jobs within the parent orchestrator run rather than searching for the reusable workflow's own run.

friction: The root cause of both bugs was a mismatch between how GitHub surfaces workflow_call runs in the API versus how the gate was querying for them — not obvious from the workflow YAML alone.
User interrupted mid-fix to ask about manually dispatched runs, requiring a pause to audit the filtering logic before continuing.
open_items: Fallback support for standalone web-e2e.yml and desktop-e2e.yml dispatches was explicitly deferred — currently the only valid manual unblock path is dispatching ci-e2e.yml on main.
The fix was committed to a feature branch but not yet merged or pushed for PR review.
